name: search inside #general

regions_read.verdict_on_region: an app-inserted scope chip inside the search field ('in: general'); names where the search is looking — counted, weakly: the word 'Search' itself is not drawn
Members / Media / Pins / Threads / Links / Files tabs with the current one underlined; the underline moved live when another tab was tapped — counted as a sub-location

identifier_class: header + navigation with visible active state
initial_rationale: the scope chip 'in: general' names the channel being searched, and the Members tab is underlined; the word 'Search' is only implied by the magnifier glyph

test_cases.action: tap the search glyph in the top bar
test_cases.expected_result: a scope chip or title names where the search is
test_cases.confirms_if: nothing names the channel or the fact of searching
test_cases.overturns_if: a chip or title names the scope
test_cases.observed_result: reproduced the capture: the field opens with an app-inserted chip 'in: general' and the cursor after it; tabs Members / Media / Pins / Threads / Links / Files with Members underlined. The word 'Search' is not drawn; the chip is the only place name

deciding_evidence: tested live: reproduced the capture: the field opens with an app-inserted chip 'in: general' and the cursor after it; tabs Members / Media / Pins / Threads / Links / Files with Members underlined. The word 'Search' is not drawn; the chip is the only place name
recommendation: draw the word 'Search' (e.g. 'Search in #general') rather than relying on the chip and the magnifier glyph
